Second block front, blue: '3' at 00:01.250–00:09.750; unchanged when partially covered by the hand near the end.
Initially rightmost green block, later third in the row: front '2' at 00:00.000–00:02.417, '3' at 00:02.458–00:02.750, then '2' at 00:03.250–00:09.750.
Fourth block front: green '3' at 00:03.250–00:03.625; yellow/orange '2' at 00:03.750–00:09.750.
Fifth block front, pale blue: '3' at 00:04.250–00:09.750.
Sixth block front: '3' at 00:05.250–00:05.917 while blue/green; green '5' at 00:05.958–00:09.750.
Eighth/rightmost block front, blue: '3' at 00:06.750–00:07.708; '6' at 00:07.750–00:09.750.

Right side of second blue block: '6' clearly visible at 00:02.750 and 00:03.000. Other narrow or blurred side markings are not reliable enough for character comparisons.

findings.entity: Front numeral of the original rightmost green block, later third in the row
findings.description: The clearly readable '2' at 00:02.417 becomes '3' at 00:02.458 and remains '3' at 00:02.750. The hand lifts the block, but its front face stays exposed; no face exchange, replacement label, or writing action explains the changed digit.

The held block reads '3' at 00:03.500–00:03.625, then '2' at 00:03.750, with '2' persisting after placement. Its color also changes from green to yellow/orange. The small rocking motion does not visibly turn the labeled front away or reveal another face, and no relabeling occurs.

The green front reads '3' at 00:05.875–00:05.917 and '5' at 00:05.958–00:06.000. Another '3' block becomes visible beside it during the movement, but the exposed front in the sixth position changes digit without a visible face rotation or text-editing action.

The held green block reads '3' at 00:06.625–00:06.667, then its front reads '2' at 00:06.708–00:06.750 as an additional blue '3' block appears to its right. The labeled front remains facing the camera; no visible relabeling or rotation to a different face explains the change.

The front reads '3' through 00:07.708 and becomes a clear '6' at 00:07.750, remaining '6' through the end. The hand lowers and slightly straightens the block without turning its front face out of view; no action changes the printed numeral.
